parameters.formDescription: Upload an AI-Ark people-export CSV (Full Name, Title, Seniority, Email Business, Company Name, Company Website, etc). Contacts merge into the client's ClayRoots Contacts table by Contact Key. Company data for a domain already in the table is reused verbatim; a genuinely new domain gets its company data from DiscoLike, not from AI-Ark's own columns.

values.placeholder: appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — from the Hub Clients table
Names the build table — e.g. UK Ecom AI-Ark
tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — the client's Domains table, company data source of truth
tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX — leave empty to create a new table
Optional label for this build — written onto every row
